memory.summary:
On December 14th, Caroline meets with Mei at her café around 1 AM and they discuss their AI project. She arranges a meeting for the next day at 2 PM at her café with Diego, who has ideas for a mural and exchanging seeds for the community garden. Peter updates her about an exciting discussion with Noor and Leo regarding the AI project, and they agree to meet for coffee at 1:30 PM the same day in their usual spot. Peter mentions a dinner with Caroline on October 31st, 2024, and a joint AI project discussion with Noor, Leo, and Peter on October 31st, 2024, as well as attending a play together on November 1st, 2024.

Later in the day, Caroline runs into Leo at the gym and they discuss their musical collaboration. They agree to catch up over coffee at Caroline's café around 1 PM that same day, which is also attended by Diego and Mei, making it a mini gathering. During this meeting, Caroline proposes a detour for street tacos from Diego after the meeting, to which Noor agrees, and they plan to bring their harmonicas for impromptu music later.

Additionally, Caroline talks to Diego at the park on December 14th, 2025, where she proposes a meeting at her café the following day at 1 PM to discuss their AI project and a latte art workshop. Diego agrees, and they plan regular meetings every Tuesday starting from the next week. Caroline also talks to Andy at the gym around noon on the same day and proposes discussing AI project ideas over coffee at her café later that day at 2 PM. Andy suggests inviting Peter and Noor as well.
